success: sandbox.missing.wrapper returns payload and matter effects consistent with the declared outputs when it succeeds.

failure: sandbox.missing.wrapper fails when required inputs or matter contracts are not satisfied.
The capacity fails when the underlying runtime or wrapper cannot satisfy the declared contract.
notes: This contract constrains expected behavior and observable effects, not the internal implementation decomposition.
